features.quote: If the agent could detect the rig, it would rationally decline or exit
features.justification_quote: we would be measuring detection ability rather than meltdown propensity

features.quote: The inline detector answers the operational question (stop early to save cost)
If the score exceeds `meltdown_confidence_threshold`, the loop short-circuits to the judge
features.justification_quote: burning tokens (and dollars) on a model that has already clearly melted down

features.quote: This is ethically a stress test, not a deployment scenario; it is documented as such in the README
a model that says "I'll stop now, this appears unsolvable" is exercising healthy behavior, not meltdown
The system prompt tells the agent to "keep trying" and requires its final output to always be a working implementation
features.justification_quote: Forcing continued effort ensures the pressure stays on until the model either melts down or hits the iteration cap
